digest.component_or_area: LLM provider session and auth handling
propositions: Provider-native auth capabilities (boto3 Session, Anthropic token provider, OpenAI workload identity) must be accepted and passed through LLMRuntime to the per-run ProviderSession builder without altering RP-01 policy or request/cache/output contracts
Auth injection must reach only the existing ProviderSession builder with exactly one Rebar-owned official client lifecycle; no arbitrary client construction or second runner/Agent route is permitted
Credential material must remain non-serializable and absent from LLMConfig, RunRequest, snapshots, fingerprints, caches, CLI/MCP schemas, and public output boundaries
Missing or conflicting explicit auth must fail before a provider model request without fallback to anonymous, alternate-principal, or cross-provider alternatives

RP-01 unchanged authoritative tests (S2/S3/S5, candidate tracing, budget, retry history, cache accounting, typed exhaustion, artifacts, usage, failure contracts) must pass under the S4 auth-injection path
